answers.goal: My ultimate goal is to be a creative development executive and a producer to make more stories.
answers.drew: I was always a storyteller as a kid, pursued theatre all throughout my life and got bit by the film bug one day and never looked back. Now I get to mesh what I love with my work and tell stories through writing, producing, and acting.
answers.seeking: Other entry level assistants that are pursuing the producing path! I want to meet more hard working women and queer artists with the same vision and passion!
answers.inspiration: My biggest inspiration right now is Maria Fortese, a creative VP at Amblin Entertainment. She's a Drexel grad and is serving as an amazing mentor to me and helping me to establish more confidence in my voice as I try to break in to the industry. She's been helping me look at work life balance, creative point of view, and my perspective as a woman in the film industry (especially in a tough field like producing).
